title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 7: the question about fasting, the call to true judgment and kindness, and the people who refused to listen.

questions.text: In which month, named in the first verse, did Yahweh's word come to Zechariah?
questions.explanation: The word came in the fourth year of king Darius, on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

answers.text: The month Shebat
The month of harvest
The month of Chislev
The month of the feast

questions.text: Whom did the people of Bethel send to entreat Yahweh's favor?
questions.explanation: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech, and their men, to entreat Yahweh's favor.

answers.text: Sharezer and Regem Melech
Heldai and Tobijah
Joshua and Zerubbabel
Berechiah and Iddo

questions.text: What did they come to ask the priests and the prophets?
questions.explanation: They asked, "Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?"

answers.text: Whether the temple would be finished
Whether they should weep in the fifth month
Whether they should return to Babylon
Whether the land would give its fruit

questions.text: In which months does Yahweh say they had fasted and mourned?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether, when they fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month, they fasted at all to him.

answers.text: The first and the second month
The third and the ninth month
The fourth and the tenth month
The fifth and the seventh month

questions.text: For how long does he say they had done this?
questions.explanation: He speaks of their fasting and mourning in the fifth and the seventh month for these seventy years.

answers.text: Seven years
Seventy years
Forty years
Twenty years

questions.text: What question does Yahweh ask about their eating and drinking?
questions.explanation: He asks, "When you eat, and when you drink, don't you eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?"

answers.text: Whether they eat and drink for themselves
Whether they eat the bread of the temple
Whether they drink the new wine first
Whether they share with the priests

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies tell them to do toward one another?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says, "Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother."

answers.text: Keep the fasts faithfully
Bring their offerings in silence
Execute true judgment and show kindness
Build the house before their own houses

questions.text: Whom were they told not to oppress?
questions.explanation: They were told not to oppress the widow, nor the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor, and not to devise evil against a brother in their heart.

answers.text: The priest, the prophet and the judge
The king, his princes and his servants
The merchant, the farmer and the shepherd
The widow, the fatherless, the foreigner and the poor

questions.text: How did the people respond to these words?
questions.explanation: They refused to listen, turned their backs and stopped their ears, and made their hearts as hard as flint.

answers.text: They wept and fasted for many days
They refused to listen and made their hearts hard as flint
They sent men to the prophets for an answer
They repaired the temple and its courts

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies say he will do with them among the nations?
questions.explanation: He says he will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known, and the land was left desolate after them.

answers.text: He will gather them to Jerusalem
He will hide them in the mountains
He will scatter them with a whirlwind
He will give them a new name
